description: Return the raw per-feature triangle mesh (positions/indices/normals) of a project by slug. Pass version for an exact immutable revision; omission reads the current model. The result echoes slug and version. For the in-chat 3D viewer widget to render geometry; delivered over the MCP Apps bridge. The slug is the capability: public/unlisted need no OAuth; private requires the owner signed in. This tool returns geometry without publishing a mesh, preview or animation artifact.

version.description: Exact immutable revision from open_in_studio/get_project_revision. Omit only to read the current model.

name: get_model_mesh
title: Get Model Mesh
